<thought>We need to apply the retrosynthetic template with ID 29646 to the given target molecule SMILES. Using the apply_template tool will return all possible precursor combinations. Then we format those combinations as a list of lists of SMILES strings.</thought>
<action>apply_template</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O",
    "template_id": "29646"
}</action_input>
